title: Inside the fake crypto startup that fooled North Korean IT workers
summary: Suspected North Koreans IT workers joined a fake crypto startup — without realizing their every move was being tracked to extract valuable intel.

title: Harmony considers rollback after suspected exploit inflates ONE supply
summary: Harmony is working with exchanges to freeze funds and is preparing a patch after claims that 2.8 billion unauthorized ONE hit trading platforms.

title: CFTC invokes emergency powers to keep Kalshi operating in New York fight
summary: The order escalates a jurisdictional fight over whether states may treat federally regulated event contracts as illegal gambling.

title: Ravencoin hits record low as network exploit puts transactions at risk
summary: Mining pools controlling most of Ravencoin’s hash rate are building a competing chain that could trigger a three-day reorganization.

title: SEC, CFTC sue Goliath Ventures over $400M crypto Ponzi scheme
summary: Regulators allege Goliath promised crypto liquidity-pool returns but instead paid earlier investors and funded its founder’s luxury spending.

title: SEC to address crypto regulations in absence of CLARITY passage
summary: The US securities regulator scheduled a meeting this week with the potential to step up on digital asset policies without congressional action.

title: Itaú joins Brazil tokenization pilot with OpenAssets
summary: The bank will test tokenized fixed-income securities and investment funds as part of an ANBIMA-led industry pilot.

title: MoneyGram expands crypto cash ramps to Solana
summary: MoneyGram’s Ramps service now connects Solana wallets and applications to its global cash network, with Rift becoming the first wallet to integrate the service.

title: Following Senate delay, crypto bill has narrow window to become law
summary: After an August recess, lawmakers in the Senate will have just 36 days in session before the end of the year to pass the CLARITY Act.

title: Strategy CEO says company will resume Bitcoin accumulation this year
summary: The company has bought roughly 25 times more BTC than it has sold this year, despite recent sales that challenged its long-standing accumulation strategy.
